Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

HARNESS (DOBBY AND JACQUARD) 

( First Revision ) 



(Reaffirmed 2012) 



Scope — Prescribes requirements for: 

a) Dobby harness, with or without elastic cord; and 

b) Jacquard harness including lingoes. 
Shape and Dimensions 

All dimensions in millimetres.

fS: 3340 -1976 

2.1 The mails should either be made from rust-proof material or suitably coated to prevent them 
from rusting. 

2«2 The top leash shall be knotted at a distance of about 25 mm from its extreme end. 

3. Specific Requirements 

3.1 Dobby Harness 

3.1.1 Cord for top and bottom /eas/?es — Shall be of adequate strength so as to impart to the 
finished dobby harness a breaking load of 6 kgf*, Min when tested in accordance with IS : 1670-1970 
' Method of test for breaking load, elongation at break and tenacity of yarns ( first revision ) '. 

3.1.2 Elastic cord I optional ) — 40 ± 2 cm in length and 5 mm in circumference; capable of being 
stretched up to 2*5 times its original length and regain its shape after the stretch is removed. 

3.1.3 The bottom leash and top leash shall not become loose in the thread hole of the mail when 
the harness is subjected to a gentle force. 

3.2 for Jacquard Harness 

3.2.1 Lingoes — 330, 350 or 380 mm long and of mass as specified by the purchaser; made of steel 
or lead bar of suitable shape and galvanized or painted to prevent corrosion. 

3.2.2 Twines for lower and upper coupling loop and mounting thread— Oi 18, 15 or 10 kgf*, Min 
breaking strength (when tested in accordance with 18:1670-1970) depending upon loom-wise or 
fabric-wise end-use of jacquard harness ( as specified by the purchaser ), 

3.2.3 Sizing and varnishing — The jacquard harness (sized and varnished all along its length) 
should be free from lumpy surface, sticky surface, etc, and be uniformally smooth and pliable. 

4. Packing 

4.1 Dobby Harness — Preferably 1 000 harnesses shall be tied together to form a bundle. A 
convenient number of such bundles shall be wrapped in waterproof packing paper and tied securely. 

4.2 Jacquard Harness ~ A suitable number of harnesses shall be wrapped in waxed paper to form a 
bundle and a suitable number of such bundles then packed in a wooden case, 

5- Marking — Each packet or bundle shall bear the following information: 

a) Number of harnesses in the bundle, 

b) Name of the manufacturer and/or trade-mark, and 

c) Designation of the harness as given below: 

1) Dobby harness x length of top leash (mm) x length of bottom leash (mm) x whether 
with or without elastic cord 

2) Jacquard harness x type of mail Ml, M2 or M3 x mass of lingoes ( g). 
5.1 ISl Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
